name: Sam
label: Frustrated subscriber stuck with billing
who: I'm on a paid Premium plan, sometimes bought with gift cards or in multi-month blocks, and I've had trouble with trials, renewals and cancellations. I care most about not being charged after cancelling and keeping access to the music I paid for.
value_for_money: Focuses on whether charges are correct rather than on the music itself, and is upset when a trial turns into a charge or a cancellation doesn't stop billing. Cited figures include 12 pounds lost on a trial, $12 more per year after a lapse, and 1 pound for a month free.
loyalty: Keeps paid plans to keep their music and benefits, and posts say Premium features last until the billing period ends after cancelling. The posts describe contacting support or leaving when charges go wrong, and no competing service is named.
pain_points: Free trial turns into a paid plan
Account shows Free after a gift-card purchase
Support gives the same copy-paste answer
likes: Premium features kept until the period ends
reasons_to_stay: They use Premium and value keeping its benefits through the paid period, and they have bought multi-month blocks to avoid monthly charges. Their posts are mostly about billing errors rather than the music service, and they keep their paid plans while asking for fixes.
tone: Anxious and procedural, listing steps and asking for help in plain language.
